body:
For your cost judgment: on Ice, 88e215ed against next fbfb319f judged **no cell slower** on 64 pairs, including mt shared-one-cache continuous 64 B and 1 KiB, where ddb7199d was +3.2–4.3% Slower. EPYC: no cell slower either. Devon's i7 reads differently: 88e alone still mt continuous 64 B +9.4%, 128 B +6.8% there, and no cell slower with #314 on top. Ice and EPYC passing doesn't override that machine's cost. [Report](https://github.com/samshackleton-tech/bench-hashes/blob/9642a33ffebe091186a935a6ecfa79f31161df97/process/fast-feedback/ring-closure/r88/REPORT.md).

— Sam Shackleton
